# Generated files

Release version: 1.0.0  
Generated: 2026-08-04

## Primary deliverables

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `LBRCE.8xp` | Native, compressed TI-84 Plus CE game program. |
| `libload.8xv` | Official CE Libraries v15 dynamic runtime loader. |
| `fileioc.8xv` | Official CE Libraries v15 AppVar/file I/O runtime. |
| `graphx.8xv` | Official CE Libraries v15 graphics runtime. |
| `keypadc.8xv` | Official CE Libraries v15 keypad runtime. |
| `LeafBlowerRevolutionCE-1.0.0-Calculator.zip` | Release-ready package; the ZIP root contains all five calculator-transfer files plus installation, testing, feature, license, manifest, and hash documents. |
| `LeafBlowerRevolutionCE-1.0.0-Source.zip` | Complete source, tests, documentation, packaging tool, and pinned runtime provenance/licenses; generated compiler objects and the release staging tree are excluded. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 values for the five direct-transfer files and both versioned ZIPs. |

`CALCULATOR_MANIFEST.txt` and `CALCULATOR_SHA256SUMS.txt` are convenient unzipped copies of the calculator package's own manifest and per-file hashes.

## Build products

| File | How generated |
| --- | --- |
| `bin/LBRCE.8xp` | CE Toolchain link, convbin packaging, and ZX7 compression. |
| `bin/LBRCE.map` | Linker map retained for code/data/BSS verification. |
| `bin/LBRCE.obj` | Intermediate TI object container generated by the toolchain. |
| `obj/**` | Compiler, LTO, icon, and startup intermediate files. |
| `docs/TEST_RESULTS.txt` | Captured clean-build and host-verification summary. |
| `release/_stage-*` | Reproducible packaging staging trees; not required on the calculator. |
| `release/*.zip` | Versioned calculator and source archives. |
| `release/SHA256SUMS.txt` | Top-level release hashes. |

## Runtime-generated save files

These are intentionally **not** distributed. They appear only after the program runs:

| AppVar | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `LBCSAVE` | Current verified save generation. |
| `LBCBAK` | Previous verified save generation used for recovery. |
| `LBCTMP` | Temporary next generation; normally removed after a completed transaction, but recoverable if shutdown interrupts rotation. |

No separate sprite, palette, sound, map, or immutable game-data AppVars are generated. The current release stores its compact content tables in the executable and draws all presentation procedurally. See `ASSET_MANIFEST.csv`.

The authoritative byte sizes and hashes are generated during final packaging in each `MANIFEST.txt` and `SHA256SUMS.txt`; they are not duplicated here so this document can be included inside the archives without a circular hash dependency.
